QOE::video
Description
Deprecated: This command returns a set of video QOE attributes from the current
video connection.

QOE::video width
Returns the video width.
QOE::video height
Returns the video height.
QOE::video duration
Returns the video duration.
QOE::video available
Returns 1 if a valid QOE result can be retrieved and 0 if QOE result
is not available for any reasons.
QOE::video framerate
Returns the video frame rate.
QOE::video nominal_bitrate
Returns the nominal bit rate.
QOE::video average_bitrate
Returns teh actual bit rate the client side experiences. When average
< nominal, it may indicate a degraded user experience.
QOE::video mos
Returns the overall score of the video session based on the network
condition and the static video attributes.
